top_signals.title: US, Iran Strike Oil Tankers in Biggest Attack Wave Since War's Start
top_signals.summary: Iran said on Wednesday it had attacked 10 ships near the Strait of Hormuz after the U.S. sank five Iranian oil tankers, in the biggest declared wave of tit-for-tat attacks on shipping by both sides since the start of the six-month-old war.The attacks sent the price of oil surging…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iraqi Oil Tanker Hit Amidst US-Iran Attacks
top_signals.summary: A tanker carrying about 2 million barrels of Iraqi fuel oil was struck by a drone in Iraqi territorial waters on Wednesday, port officials said, and British navy-affiliated UKMTO reported that several merchant vessels in the Gulf had been hit…

top_signals.title: e.l.f. Beauty Sees Skincare as Growth Engine
top_signals.summary: While e.l.f. Beauty's roots are in color cosmetics, the company has recently focused on building its skincare portfolio: since 2022, its launched an in-house skincare line and acquired two other brands (most recently Hailey Bieber's Rhode for $1 billion in 2025). On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Mandy Fields and CEO Tarang Amin discuss e.l.f.'s strategy with Scarlet Fu. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Innovation Propels e.l.f's Beauty Success
top_signals.summary: Developing new products and bringing them to market quickly has been an important ingredient in e.l.f. Beauty's rapid growth. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Mandy Fields tells Scarlet Fu how her finance team plays a key role in the company's innovation processes. (Source: Bloomberg)
